title: DV3 Warm Up
description: A full-ice continuous warm-up with three passing versions: D-to-D to wall, D-to-D to middle, and D-to-D with a hinge before the forwards attack for a shot.
coaching_points: Keep sticks on the ice and communicate throughout the passing sequence.
Forwards time routes so they arrive in the passing lane neither early nor late.
Defensemen move the puck cleanly while maintaining flow.
Alternate sides continuously to keep the pace high.

title: Admirals 2 Shot
description: A two-part full-ice warm-up that combines repeated passing, timing and zone-entry movement with one rush shot followed by a point shot through net-front traffic.
coaching_points: Communicate and keep sticks available throughout the sequence.
Time the middle and wall routes so passes arrive in stride.
Defensemen follow the rush and then walk the blue line for the second shot.
Forwards create traffic and stay available around the net.

title: SD Thomas 1 v 1
description: A competitive corner 1-on-1 game where the coach chips a puck into the playing area and whichever player wins possession attacks while the other immediately defends.
coaching_points: Puck carrier shields possession with strong body position.
Defender keeps the stick on the ice and combines body position with stick-on-puck.
Transition instantly when possession changes.
Keep reps competitive and short enough to maintain intensity.

title: Out Of The Corner
description: A corner retrieval drill where the offensive player collects a short rim, gets off the wall, initiates contact, cuts the defender's hands and attacks the net.
coaching_points: Retrieve the puck under control and get off the wall quickly.
Initiate contact instead of waiting for the defender to dictate the play.
Use body position and a cutback to protect the puck.
Progress from token pressure to a live 1-on-1 battle.

title: Off-Side Game
description: A cross-ice 3-on-3 game with a center offside line. Teams must regroup in their defensive half and then enter the attacking half onside before they can score.
coaching_points: Support the puck and remain available as an outlet during the regroup.
Attack with proper timing so the team stays onside.
Defenders keep sticks in lanes and angle play outside.
Treat an offside as an immediate turnover.

title: Black vs White Stick Tape Keep Away
description: A keep-away game where teams are identified by stick-tape color instead of jerseys, forcing players to scan and recognize teammates before completing passes.
coaching_points: Scan constantly to identify teammates by stick tape.
Move to open ice when your team has possession.
Protect the puck with the body until a passing lane opens.
Award points for clean tape-to-tape passes to a teammate.

title: 3 vs. 3 Handball Game
description: A no-stick, no-puck 3-on-3 handball game that develops give-and-go habits, support, communication and movement to open space using a ball or similar object.
coaching_points: Move the ball within two seconds to force quick decisions.
Support the ball carrier as an immediate outlet.
Use give-and-go movement to create separation.
If the ball hits the ice, change possession.

title: Battery Hockey Figure 8 Shooting Drill
description: A six-shot shooting progression where the shooter receives passes from both corners, then adds pivots and controlled turns around cones before releasing quick shots.
coaching_points: Keep the stick on the ice and give the passer a clear target.
Keep both hands away from the body to prepare a quick release.
Receive the puck in shooting position after each pivot or turn.
Rotate the shooter into a passing role after the sequence.

title: Skilled Passing to 1 on 1 Battle Drill
description: A two-part drill that starts with a skilled passing sequence and back-door scoring attempt, then immediately transitions into a live 1-on-1 corner battle.
coaching_points: Complete the early passing skill at speed and with precision.
Time the back-door route for a quick scoring touch.
Transition instantly into the 1-on-1 battle when the coach rims the next puck.
Keep battle shifts short and highly competitive.

title: Neutral Zone 3 vs. 3 Game
description: A neutral-zone 3-on-3 game designed to create frequent turnovers and transitions. Coaches or support players on the blue lines feed new pucks back into play when the puck leaves the zone.
coaching_points: Keep the head up and scan for teammates, opponents and new pucks.
Keep sticks on the ice for both passing targets and defensive lanes.
Communicate through every turnover and restart.
Players without the puck move into space and become outlets.
